description: Extract complete text from caller-supplied canonical base64 DOCX bytes using the bounded Creora document parser. Returns actual text, source/text SHA256 and ordered document parts. No URL or file lookup, network, OCR, PDF, macros, field evaluation or external writes. Refuses unsupported or over-budget documents instead of truncating. Official documentation: https://creora.darwin.so/providers/files/docs

inputSchema.description: Use the owned file transport's existing 128KiB canonical byte budget.
inputSchema.title: SuppliedDocxInput

name: docx_to_text

outputSchema.description: Whole actual extracted text and hashes; no stored or inferred result.
outputSchema.title: SuppliedDocxText
